{{Top|leg}}
The '''target tracker''' was a component of a [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] responsible for tracking individual threats, predicting their possible movements, and automatically adjusting the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] fire control and flight control systems.
